topics.title: Disjointed Conversations and Nail Polish
topics.summary: The program features fragmented conversations covering bizarre topics like an obsession with hands and nail polish, claims of alcoholism, outlandish stories about OJ Simpson, and personal struggles regarding job loss. A musician discusses her guitar playing and unique nail polishes while callers share their financial difficulties and anxieties, leading to tangential discussions about dating and past relationships.

topics.title: Meredith Brooks and the Skoldies’ Confusion
topics.summary: During a radio show segment, Howard discusses Meredith Brooks and her band The Skoldies, including Sean Colvin as a collaborator. He recounts awkward conversations about musical aspirations, financial investments in Brooks' career, and misinterpretations regarding Brooks’ age and relationship with Jackie, leading to humorous misunderstandings and speculation.”} 36 words”**

topics.title: Music Militia Disrupts Grammy Awards
topics.summary: A group calling itself the Music Militia plans to disrupt the upcoming Grammy awards, claiming they are ‘raping’ the creative landscape. Approximately 5000 members intend to surround Radio City Music Hall with musical instruments and stage a 'sonic riot' against corporate control of music, expressing frustration about perceived industry exploitation.

topics.title: Bacteria, Tornadoes & A Confused Scientist
topics.summary: A report details rising deaths from a deadly bacterium linked to food poisoning alongside ongoing searches for victims after devastating Florida tornadoes. An investigation into terrorism charges involving a man possessing toxic substances concluded with his claims of wanting to ‘help mankind,’ while discussions about Puerto Rico’s potential statehood and a former suspect in tornado-related crimes expressed intentions to aid humanity.

topics.title: California Storm & James Brolin Incident
topics.summary: Severe storms caused extensive damage in Southern California with flooding and mudslides while a dispute arose over actor James Brolin’s alleged assault on a photographer. The incident was downgraded to harassment charges due to minor injuries, followed by reports of Louise Woodward celebrating her 20th birthday with modest gifts from fellow inmates after being accused of murdering Matthew Eapan.

topics.title: Radio Host Chaos – Lottery, Illness, Suicide
topics.summary: During a chaotic broadcast, Kenny repeatedly cries while attempting to damage furniture before Robin reports on Reverend Paul McDonald winning the Massachusetts lottery and Naomi Judd announcing her hepatitis C cure with advice for others. Michael Hutchins’ suicide is discussed alongside David Hyde Pierce receiving an award at the American Comedy Awards; Jackie Marling sells CDs.
